annotations.title: The saddest and happiest classic novels, ranked by measured sentiment

description:
Classic novels ranked by the sentiment of their full text: overall mood, mood of the ending, or how far the mood moves from first page to last. Optional year range. 339 novels scored, 1678-1928.

Example questions:
- "What is the saddest classic novel?"
- "Which Victorian novels have the happiest endings?"
- "Novels that get darker as they go"

measure.description: overall = whole text (default), ending = last 10%, change = end minus start
